item.description:
# SakuraCord v0.1.7-Beta-10
## SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 10 (macOS 26 port)
Unofficial macOS 26.5 build of SakuraCord nightly, put together by UnxnownYT.
### From upstream (Beta 9 + Beta 10) - Favorites server, scheduled messages, @silent messages, pinned channels and a message font size setting. - Rebuilt forum post composer and game profiles; your theme colour is now the real macOS accent. - Drafts kept in threads and forum posts, better search in DMs, custom emoji in reply previews, double-click to open videos. - Large internal reorganisation (should behave the same; please report anything odd).
### Activity (PR #528 by DinanathDash, latest version) - Spotify / Apple Music, games and local RPC on your status and profile, and other people's activity on theirs. - Activity settings moved to Settings → Features, with a drag-to-reorder priority list.
### Port - Builds with Swift 6.3 / Xcode 26.6 on macOS 26.5.
### Notes - Ad-hoc signed. On first launch, right-click → Open (or allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security). - Up- Up- Up- Up- Up- Up- Up- Up- Up- Up- Up- Uy feed.
